<description>
**Problem:** `createrawtransaction` accepts a JSON number as `data` when its digits form valid hex. For example, it treats `99` as the string `"99"` and writes the byte `0x99` to the output.

**Fix:** Pass the original JSON value to the hex parser so it can enforce the documented string type.
</description>

<commits>
f0518a30af rpc: require a hex string for OP_RETURN data

Pass the original JSON value to ParseHexV so it can check the type before decoding the data. Extend the existing RPC test to reject numeric 99 alongside the existing coverage for the string "99".
</commits>
